outcome: Review is no longer plan-blind: decomposition tasks can declare plan_contracts (the plan invariants they must satisfy), ./forge review-brief composes the reviewer's contract prompt (per-task or --all for the branch-wide closeout), the quality review artifact must verdict every declared contract with evidence — partial or missing verdicts become blocking findings — and pr-ready refuses until every contract is verified implemented. Incomplete implementation now blocks the gate instead of passing invisibly; tasks without contracts behave exactly as before.
